resources.string: Lets Snib see which app is opening, so it can hold the block.
Snib needs this to know which app has just opened. It is the only way an app on Android can block another app. Snib reads nothing else, sends nothing anywhere, and works entirely on this phone.
Optional. Makes Snib take an extra deliberate step to uninstall. Snib cannot lock, wipe, or manage your phone.
Shows while your phone is snibbed.
Shows while an emergency break is running.
